field_edits.updated_text: There is near-complete resolution of prior marrow edema/bone contusions involving the acetabular walls, femoral head, femoral neck, and greater trochanter. No acute fracture, avascular necrosis, or aggressive osseous lesion. Normal marrow signal is demonstrated.
There is a minimal residual hip joint effusion, markedly decreased compared to the prior study. No trochanteric bursitis.
